campaign.title: 🚀 Become a Haldiram's Retail Partner!
campaign.body:
Hi Ramesh! 🙏

Haldiram's is back on your shelf. Explore new products, festive schemes & easy ordering — all on WhatsApp.

✅ Direct from Haldiram's
✅ Festive schemes & rewards
✅ AI-powered ordering

Tap Register Now below!

submitted.title: Application Received
submitted.body:
Dear Ramesh Patel,

Thank you for submitting your application to become a Retail Partner of Haldiram's India.

Our team will review your details and get back to you shortly. You will be automatically notified on this channel for any queries or upon successful registration.

We look forward to welcoming you as a partner!

welcome.title: 🎉 Welcome to Haldiram's Retailer Network!
welcome.body:
Congratulations Ramesh Patel! 🎉

Your store Ganesh General Stores is now an approved Haldiram's Retail Partner.

Tap Open Menu below to access your self-service dashboard — order Namkeen, check schemes, view invoices, and more.

campaign.title: 🪔 Diwali Festive Offer
campaign.body:
Stock up for Diwali! 🪔

Bhujia, Mathri & Assorted Gift Packs are selling out fast. Special scheme on orders above ₹10,000 — extra 5% off + free display stand.

Limited period offer!

scheme.title: 💰 Current Scheme — Bhujia Range
scheme.body:
Buy 10 ctns Aloo Bhujia 400g → Get 2 ctns FREE + ₹500 ZoPs credited to your account.

Valid till 31 Oct 2026.

Tap below to place your order with scheme pricing applied automatically.

aiTyping.body: Scheme query detected, ZoAi is composing a response...

aiResponse.title: ZoAi Scheme Explanation
aiResponse.body: Bhai, is scheme mein aapko har 10 cartoons Aloo Bhujia 400g par 2 cartoons FREE mil rahe hain. Matlab aap 10 ka pay karenge aur 12 ka maal milega. Plus ₹500 ZoPoints jo next order mein discount ki tarah use kar sakte hain. Scheme 31 Oct 2026 tak valid hai. Kya aap order dena chahenge? 😊
